decisions.reason: A recently launched safety shoe line is the firm's core business, and such multi-model lines normally stay on the market for several years to recover development and certification costs.
The comfort insole is a cheap complementary accessory that supports shoe sales, though the insole range is being consolidated, as the withdrawal of Product C showed.
The ergonomic series has its own web page and serves a growing segment, so the firm is likely to keep investing in it.
Certified firefighter and rescue boots serve a specialist niche with long procurement cycles, which makes early withdrawal unlikely.
The moulded insole is the firm's flagship insole on the home page and likely took over C's role, so the firm will keep backing it.
